summary.zh-CN: 一位年轻女性从昨天起一次次晕倒：在急诊弄清原因、保证她的安全，再沿着她这次住院记录下来的经过一路复盘。
summary.en: A young woman has blacked out again and again since yesterday: work out why and keep her safe in the emergency department, then follow her recorded admission to its end.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 当晕倒伴尿失禁、情绪诱因和醒后呕吐时，把病史与 12 导联心电图放在一起，区分心律失常性晕厥、癫痫发作和反射性晕厥，并把已知长 QT 综合征患者的晕倒按高危晕厥处理（ESC 2018 晕厥指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish arrhythmic syncope from epileptic seizure and reflex syncope when blackouts come with urinary incontinence, an emotional trigger and vomiting, by setting the history beside a 12-lead ECG, and treat blackouts in known long-QT syndrome as high-risk syncope (ESC 2018 syncope).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别已知长 QT 综合征患者 QTc 0.58 s、室性早搏二联律合并血钾 3.3 mmol/L 意味着随时可能发生尖端扭转型室速，并立即给予持续心电监护、备好除颤（ESC 2018 晕厥指南；ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise a QTc of 0.58 s with ventricular bigeminy and a potassium of 3.3 mmol/L in known long-QT syndrome as an imminent risk of torsade de pointes, and start continuous ECG monitoring with a defibrillator ready at once (ESC 2018 syncope; ESC 2022 VA/SCD).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 处理先天性长 QT 综合征的尖端扭转：持续或无脉的发作立即电除颤，硫酸镁 2 g（8 mmol）静脉注射，血钾维持 4.5–5.0 mmol/L，恢复非选择性 β 受体阻滞剂；避免胺碘酮和昂丹司琼等延长 QT 的药物，发作仍反复时以起搏而不是异丙肾上腺素提高心率（英国复苏委员会 2026 快速性心律失常流程；ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南；AHA/ACCF 2010；美国 FDA 2011）。
learningOutcomes.en: Treat torsade de pointes in congenital long-QT syndrome: defibrillate sustained or pulseless runs at once, give magnesium sulfate 2 g (8 mmol) IV, keep potassium at 4.5–5.0 mmol/L and restart a non-selective beta-blocker; avoid amiodarone and QT-prolonging drugs such as ondansetron, and if runs persist raise the rate by pacing rather than isoprenaline (RCUK 2026 tachyarrhythmia algorithm; ESC 2022 VA/SCD; AHA/ACCF 2010; US FDA 2011).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把恢复后仍为 0.61 s 的 QTc、去神经术后 7 年在停药期间的复发判断为持续高危，并说明情绪诱因只能提示、不能确定基因分型（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a QTc that stays at 0.61 s after recovery, and a recurrence seven years after left cardiac sympathetic denervation while off the beta-blocker, as persisting high risk, and explain why an emotional trigger suggests but cannot establish a genotype (ESC 2022 VA/SCD).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制订出院前的二级预防：足量非选择性 β 受体阻滞剂和坚持服药的办法、由遗传性心律失常团队评估 ICD、遗传咨询与基因检测、一级亲属心电图筛查，以及避免延长 QT 药物的清单（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南；EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 基因检测共识）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan secondary prevention before discharge: a full-dose non-selective beta-blocker with an adherence plan, an ICD assessment by an inherited-arrhythmia team, genetic counselling and testing, ECG screening of first-degree relatives and a list of QT-prolonging drugs to avoid (ESC 2022 VA/SCD; EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 genetic testing consensus).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明这份单病例报告能说明什么、不能说明什么：出院后 1 年余没有再晕厥，并不证明在 QTc 仍为 0.61 s 时风险已经消失。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain what this single report can and cannot show: more than a year without syncope after discharge does not prove that the risk has gone while the QTc remains 0.61 s.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——28岁女性；7 年前因长 QT 和危险心律失常就诊，行左心交感神经切除，术后服普萘洛尔约 1 年后自行停药；入院前 1 天起反复晕厥，本次在情绪激动后发作，首次几分钟后苏醒，晕厥时尿失禁，醒后头晕、乏力、恶心呕吐；家中无类似晕厥；查体意识清楚但精神差，听力和发育正常，双肺清晰，心律齐、无杂音；心电图 QTc 0.58 s 伴室性早搏二联律；入院血钾 3.3 mmol/L；心脏超声结构与功能正常；监护记录反复尖端扭转型室速，部分数秒后自行终止、部分需紧急电复律；给予补钾补镁、电复律并恢复普萘洛尔，稳定时 QTc 0.61 s，住院 11 天出院，随访 1 年余无晕厥——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。急诊—监护病床—病房的分阶段安排、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、血镁、发作次数与电击能量、药物剂量、基因型、ICD 讨论、更远期随访）保持未知。原报告的心电图图片带有采集日期和病历号，未获准展示，本例只依据文字报告教学。1.0.0 版内部的一处出入予以保留：入院查体记录“心律齐”，心电图却记录室性早搏二联律（两者的时间都没有记录）。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 28-year-old woman; seen seven years earlier for long QT and a dangerous arrhythmia and treated by left cardiac sympathetic denervation, after which she took propranolol for about a year and then stopped it herself; repeated syncope from the day before admission, this episode following emotional upset, the first time coming round after a few minutes, with urinary incontinence and afterwards dizziness, weakness, nausea and vomiting; no similar syncope in the family; on examination alert but unwell, hearing and development normal, lungs clear, regular rhythm without murmur; ECG QTc 0.58 s with ventricular bigeminy; admission potassium 3.3 mmol/L; normal cardiac structure and function on echocardiography; recurrent torsade de pointes on monitoring, some runs ending after seconds and others needing emergency electrical cardioversion; potassium and magnesium supplementation, cardioversion and propranolol restarted, QTc 0.61 s once stable, discharge after 11 days and no syncope over more than a year of follow-up — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The staging (emergency department, monitored bed, ward), the decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, magnesium level, number of episodes and shock energies, drug doses, genotype, any ICD discussion, longer follow-up) stays unknown. The report's ECG figure carries acquisition dates and record numbers and is withheld, so the case teaches from the written reports. One discrepancy in version 1.0.0 is kept: the admission examination records a regular rhythm while the ECG records ventricular bigeminy (the time of neither is recorded).

personality.en: A 28-year-old woman frightened by blacking out again and again since yesterday and worn out after the attacks; she answers what she is asked, briefly. She says only what she knows; when she does not know, she says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.en: Plain, short sentences without medical terms; for her heart condition she uses the name doctors gave her years ago, 'long QT'.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我又晕倒了，而且不止一次。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've blacked out again — and not just once.

concerns.en: Doctor, is this going to keep happening?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：在急诊时她醒着，但精神很差，躺在推床上，怕再晕过去；住进监护病床后仍然害怕；病情稳定、转到普通病房后平静一些，最关心以后会不会再犯。只回答被问到的内容；不提心电图、化验或任何数字，不编造病史、用药、过敏或家族史。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: in the emergency department she is awake but looks unwell, lying on the trolley and afraid of blacking out again; on the monitored bed she is still frightened; on the ward, once she has stabilised, she is calmer and mostly wants to know whether it will happen again. She answers only what she is asked, never mentions ECGs, blood tests or numbers, and never invents history, medicines, allergies or family history.

description.zh-CN: 她从昨天起反复晕倒，刚到急诊：采集病史、查体，记录并阅读心电图和血液检查，决定现在怎么处理、收到哪里。
description.en: She has been blacking out since yesterday and has just arrived in the emergency department: take the history, examine her, record and read the ECG and bloods, and decide what to do now and where she goes.

description.zh-CN: 她已收入可持续心电监护、随时能除颤的病床。这一阶段查阅发作时的监护记录和心脏超声，并处理反复的发作。
description.en: She has been admitted to a bed with continuous ECG monitoring and a defibrillator at hand. This phase covers the monitor recordings of her attacks, the echocardiogram and the treatment of the recurring attacks.

description.zh-CN: 发作已经控制住，她转到普通病房准备出院：复查心电图，判断今后的风险，制订出院计划。
description.en: The attacks are under control and she has moved to the ward ahead of discharge: repeat the ECG, judge her future risk and plan her discharge.

description.en: Review the recorded treatment, discharge and follow-up; nothing beyond about a year is recorded.

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针，同时抽血送检（电解质、镁）。
dose.en: Peripheral IV cannula, with blood samples sent at the same time (electrolytes, magnesium).

dose.zh-CN: 硫酸镁 2 g（8 mmol）静脉注射，10 分钟以上推完；尖端扭转再发时可重复。
dose.en: Magnesium sulfate 2 g (8 mmol) IV over 10 minutes; repeat if torsade recurs.

response.zh-CN: 硫酸镁已给。记录显示住院期间给予了补钾、补镁；本病例没有记录剂量、途径和时间，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Magnesium given. The record shows potassium and magnesium supplementation during the admission; it does not record the doses, routes or timing, and the case does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 氯化钾口服，或稀释后经输液泵静脉滴注（绝不静脉推注），使血钾达到并维持在 4.5–5.0 mmol/L；静脉补钾前查肾功能，并复查血钾。
dose.en: Potassium chloride by mouth, or diluted by infusion pump IV (never as an IV push), to bring potassium to 4.5–5.0 mmol/L and keep it there; check renal function before IV replacement and recheck the level.

response.zh-CN: 已开始补钾。记录显示住院期间给予了补钾、补镁；本病例没有记录剂量、途径和之后的血钾值，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Potassium replacement started. The record shows potassium and magnesium supplementation during the admission; it does not record the doses, routes or later potassium values, and the case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 非选择性 β 受体阻滞剂（恢复普萘洛尔）

dose.zh-CN: 普萘洛尔（或纳多洛尔）口服，重新开始并逐步加量至可耐受的足量；每次给药前查心率和血压。
dose.en: Propranolol (or nadolol) by mouth, restarted and titrated up to the full tolerated dose, checking heart rate and blood pressure before each dose.

response.zh-CN: 已恢复普萘洛尔。记录显示住院期间重新使用了普萘洛尔；本病例没有记录剂量、途径和开始的时间，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Propranolol restarted. The record shows propranolol was resumed during the admission; it does not record the dose, route or day, and the case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 核查并停用延长 QT 的药物

dose.zh-CN: 核对全部在用和拟用药物，停用一切延长 QT 的药物（包括部分止吐药、抗菌药和抗精神病药），并在病历和医嘱系统中标注“长QT——避免延长 QT 的药物”。
dose.en: Check every current and planned drug, stop anything that prolongs the QT (including some antiemetics, antibiotics and antipsychotics), and flag the notes and prescribing system 'long QT — avoid QT-prolonging drugs'.

response.zh-CN: 用药已核对，病历已标注。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The drug chart is checked and flagged. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 收入可持续心电监护的病床

dose.zh-CN: 收入可持续心电监护、随时能除颤的床位（CCU 或监护病房），由心内科接管。
dose.en: Admit to a bed with continuous ECG monitoring and immediate defibrillation (CCU or a monitored unit) under cardiology.

response.zh-CN: 她正被转到监护病床。本病例没有记录收治她的科室或病区，也不模拟转运的效果。
response.en: She is being moved to a monitored bed. This case does not record which unit admitted her and does not simulate the transfer.

dose.zh-CN: 持续不止或已无脉的尖端扭转：立即非同步电击（除颤能量）；数秒后自行终止的短阵发作不需电击。
dose.en: Torsade that keeps going or has left her pulseless: an unsynchronised shock at defibrillation energy at once; runs that stop by themselves after a few seconds need no shock.

harm.zh-CN: 此时没有正在发作、需要电击的尖端扭转：在急诊她神志清楚，有灌注心律；到了病房，发作已经控制。电击只用于持续不止或已导致无脉的发作——室颤和无脉室速用非同步电除颤（ERC 2025 成人高级生命支持指南），神志清楚而有危及生命表现的快速性心律失常在镇静下同步电复律（英国复苏委员会 2026 快速性心律失常流程）。对有灌注的心律电击会带来疼痛，本身还可能诱发室颤；保持电极贴好、除颤仪备用即可。
harm.en: No run of torsade is in progress to shock: in the emergency department she is alert with a perfusing rhythm, and on the ward her attacks are under control. Shocks are for a run that persists or leaves her pulseless — unsynchronised for VF or pulseless VT (ERC 2025 adult ALS), synchronised under sedation for a tachyarrhythmia with life-threatening features in a conscious patient (RCUK 2026 tachyarrhythmia algorithm). A shock into a perfusing rhythm hurts and can itself start VF; keep the pads on and the defibrillator ready instead.

response.zh-CN: 已电击。记录显示她有的发作需要紧急电复律；本病例没有记录电击次数和能量，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Shock delivered. The record shows some of her episodes needed emergency electrical cardioversion; it does not record the number or energy of the shocks, and the case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 请心律失常（电生理）团队会诊

dose.zh-CN: 请心律失常团队床旁会诊：发作仍反复时评估加强治疗（包括临时起搏提高心率），并参与制订长期方案。
dose.en: Ask the arrhythmia team to the bedside: escalation if the runs keep recurring (including temporary pacing to raise the heart rate), and the long-term plan.

response.zh-CN: 心律失常团队已知晓，正赶来会诊。本病例没有记录这一步，也没有记录是否用过临时起搏；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The arrhythmia team is on its way. This case does not record this step or whether temporary pacing was used; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉注射昂丹司琼止吐

dose.zh-CN: 昂丹司琼 4 mg 静脉注射。

harm.zh-CN: 昂丹司琼会延长 QT 间期；美国 FDA（2011 年药品安全通讯）要求先天性长 QT 综合征患者避免使用。对已知长 QT 的她再加一种延长 QT 的药物，会增加尖端扭转的风险（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南：长 QT 患者避免延长 QT 的药物）。任何止吐药都先对照延长 QT 药物清单核查，并先纠正低钾。
harm.en: Ondansetron prolongs the QT interval, and the US FDA (Drug Safety Communication, 2011) advises avoiding it in congenital long-QT syndrome. Adding a QT-prolonging drug in her known long QT raises the risk of torsade (ESC 2022 VA/SCD: avoid QT-prolonging drugs in LQTS). Check any antiemetic against a QT-drug list first, and correct the potassium.

response.zh-CN: 昂丹司琼已注射。本病例没有记录用过止吐药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Ondansetron given. This case records no antiemetic and does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 胺碘酮 300 mg 静脉注射，随后静脉维持。
dose.en: Amiodarone 300 mg IV, then an infusion.

harm.zh-CN: 尖端扭转时避免胺碘酮：它本身延长 QT 间期，可使尖端扭转更易发作（英国复苏委员会快速性心律失常流程，2026 年 3 月修订；ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南：长 QT 患者避免延长 QT 的药物）。她反复发作的尖端扭转正是这种心律，应以镁剂、补钾和对持续发作电击来处理，而不是套用心搏骤停流程里的胺碘酮。
harm.en: Avoid amiodarone in torsade de pointes: it lengthens the QT itself and makes torsade more likely (Resuscitation Council UK tachyarrhythmia algorithm, revised March 2026; ESC 2022 VA/SCD: avoid QT-prolonging drugs in LQTS). Her recurring torsade is exactly that rhythm, so treat it with magnesium, potassium and shocks for sustained runs rather than with the arrest algorithm's amiodarone.

response.zh-CN: 胺碘酮已注射。本病例没有记录用过胺碘酮；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Amiodarone given. This case records no amiodarone and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉泵入异丙肾上腺素

dose.zh-CN: 异丙肾上腺素静脉泵入，把心率提高到每分钟 100 次左右。
dose.en: Isoprenaline by infusion pump to raise the heart rate to about 100 a minute.

harm.zh-CN: 先天性长 QT 综合征的发作若由情绪等肾上腺素能刺激诱发（她这次正是如此），肾上腺素能刺激本身就是诱因，β 受体阻滞剂才是治疗（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南），再泵入 β 受体激动剂可能诱发更多尖端扭转。英国复苏委员会 2026 快速性心律失常流程对 QT 延长的多形性室速列出异丙肾上腺素或临时起搏以提高心率，ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南则把二者推荐用于获得性长 QT 在补镁、纠正诱因后仍反复的尖端扭转；对她这种先天性、情绪诱发的长 QT，药物无效时以起搏提高心率。本病例也没有记录发作前有心动过缓或长间歇。
harm.en: In congenital long-QT syndrome whose attacks follow emotion or another adrenergic trigger — as this one did — adrenergic stimulation is itself the trigger and beta-blockade the treatment (ESC 2022 VA/SCD), so a beta-agonist infusion risks more torsade. The RCUK 2026 tachyarrhythmia algorithm lists isoprenaline or temporary pacing to raise the heart rate in polymorphic VT with QT prolongation, and ESC 2022 VA/SCD recommends either for torsade that keeps recurring in acquired long QT despite magnesium and correction of its causes; in her congenital, emotion-triggered long QT the rate is raised by pacing if drugs fail. This case also records no bradycardia or pauses before her attacks.

response.zh-CN: 异丙肾上腺素已泵入。本病例没有记录用过异丙肾上腺素；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Isoprenaline started. This case records no isoprenaline and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 出院，门诊动态心电图随访
name.en: Discharge with a Holter and clinic follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 出院：恢复普萘洛尔并口服补钾，佩戴 24 小时动态心电图，1 周内心内科门诊复诊。
dose.en: Discharge home: restart propranolol and oral potassium, a 24-hour Holter, and the cardiology clinic within a week.

harm.zh-CN: 已知长 QT 综合征、昨天起反复晕倒，属于高危晕厥，需要住院并持续心电监护（ESC 2018 晕厥指南：怀疑心律失常性晕厥的高危患者在床旁或遥测下心电监护）。动态心电图只能记录，发作时不能除颤。
harm.en: Known long-QT syndrome with repeated blackouts since yesterday is high-risk syncope that needs admission and continuous ECG monitoring (ESC 2018 syncope: monitoring in bed or by telemetry for high-risk patients with suspected arrhythmic syncope). A Holter only records; it cannot defibrillate during an attack.

response.zh-CN: 已安排出院。本病例不模拟这一选择之后的经过；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Discharge arranged. This case does not simulate what would follow; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

dose.zh-CN: 转诊遗传性心律失常（电生理）团队：在 β 受体阻滞剂基础上评估是否植入 ICD，与她共同决策并记录讨论结果。
dose.en: Refer to the inherited-arrhythmia (electrophysiology) team to assess an ICD on top of the beta-blocker, decided with her and documented.

response.zh-CN: 已转诊。本病例没有记录是否讨论或植入了 ICD；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Referral made. This case does not record whether an ICD was discussed or implanted; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 遗传咨询与基因检测知情同意
name.en: Genetic counselling and consent for testing

dose.zh-CN: 遗传咨询：说明基因检测能说明什么、不能说明什么，取得她的知情同意后送检。
dose.en: Genetic counselling: explain what testing can and cannot show, and send the test with her informed consent.

response.zh-CN: 已安排遗传咨询。本病例没有记录遗传咨询或基因检测结果；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Counselling arranged. This case records no genetic counselling or result; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 建议父母、兄弟姐妹和子女等一级亲属做 12 导联心电图；她检出致病变异后，再为亲属做针对该变异的基因检测。
dose.en: Offer her first-degree relatives (parents, siblings, children) a 12-lead ECG, and testing for her variant once a disease-causing variant is found in her.

response.zh-CN: 已向她说明家属筛查。本病例没有记录家属的筛查情况；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Screening explained to her. This case does not record any screening of her relatives; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 每天按足量服用 β 受体阻滞剂，不擅自停药；随身携带延长 QT 药物清单（如 CredibleMeds），任何新药先核查；呕吐、腹泻时尽快查血钾；避免已知诱因。
dose.en: Take the full beta-blocker dose every day and never stop it without advice; carry a list of QT-prolonging drugs (e.g. CredibleMeds) and check every new medicine against it; get a potassium check promptly with vomiting or diarrhoea; avoid known triggers.

response.zh-CN: 已完成出院宣教。本病例没有记录出院时给她的建议；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Teaching given. This case does not record the advice she was given at discharge; it does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 问清这几次晕倒的来龙去脉
title.en: Take the story of the blackouts

hint.zh-CN: 要判断这些晕倒有多危险，你还需要知道什么——发作的经过、诱因，以及她过去的心脏病、手术和用药？
hint.en: To judge how dangerous these blackouts are, what else do you need to know — how they went, what set them off, and her past heart history, operation and medicines?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问清晕倒从何时开始、经过如何、伴随什么，以及诱因、既往心脏病、手术和用药。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask when the blackouts began, how they went and what came with them, what set them off, and about her heart history, operation and medicines.

title.zh-CN: 查体，并阅读第一份心电图和血液检查
title.en: Examine her and read the first ECG and bloods

hint.zh-CN: 按顺序读这份心电图：心率、节律、各个间期——哪一个间期要按心率校正？哪些血液结果会改变你对它的判断？
hint.en: Read the tracing in order — rate, rhythm, the intervals: which interval must be corrected for heart rate, and which blood results change how you read it?

guidance.zh-CN: 检查她的神志、听力、心脏和双肺；推来心电图机记录 12 导联心电图，抽血查电解质和镁，在床旁或病历终端阅读结果；然后到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Check her consciousness, hearing, heart and lungs; bring the ECG machine for a 12-lead ECG and send bloods for electrolytes and magnesium, read the results at the bedside or a records terminal, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 决定她现在需要什么，并马上去做
title.en: Decide what she needs now, and do it

hint.zh-CN: 如果她在接下来一小时里又晕过去，你希望那时她身上和床旁已经有什么？哪些常用药会让这份心电图更危险？
hint.en: If she blacks out again in the next hour, what do you want already on her and at the bedside — and which everyday drugs would make this tracing more dangerous?

guidance.zh-CN: 到会诊板作答决策 2，然后在床旁执行：监护和除颤准备、静脉通路、纠正电解质、核查用药，并把她收到合适的床位。
guidance.en: Answer decision 2 on the case board, then act at the bedside: monitoring and a defibrillator, IV access, electrolyte correction, a drug review, and admission to the right bed.

title.zh-CN: 处理监护病床上的反复发作
title.en: Treat the attacks on the monitored bed

hint.zh-CN: 这些发作是怎样开始、怎样结束的？哪些需要电击？又是什么在继续推动它们？
hint.en: How do these runs start and stop, which of them need a shock — and what is still driving them?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端或床旁调阅发作时的监护记录和心脏超声；到床旁对持续或导致意识丧失的发作电除颤，处理诱发因素；到会诊板作答决策 3。
guidance.en: At a records terminal or the bedside, review the monitor recordings of her attacks and the echocardiogram; at the bedside, shock the runs that persist or make her collapse and treat what drives them; answer decision 3 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 出院前评估风险，制订计划
title.en: Assess her risk and plan before discharge

hint.zh-CN: 她现在平稳了——这能说明风险已经过去吗？她的家人又需要什么？
hint.en: She is settled now — does that mean the risk has passed? And what do her relatives need?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病房复查 12 导联心电图，作答决策 4 和 5，并安排出院前的转诊、咨询和宣教。
guidance.en: On the ward, repeat the 12-lead ECG, answer decisions 4 and 5, and arrange the referrals, counselling and teaching before she goes home.

hint.zh-CN: 记录的经过与你的计划有哪些相同、哪些不同？
hint.en: Where does the recorded course match your plan, and where does it differ?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅记录的治疗经过、出院和随访。
guidance.en: At a records terminal, review the recorded treatment, discharge and follow-up.

prompt.zh-CN: 她从昨天起反复晕倒：第一次几分钟后醒来，晕倒时尿失禁，醒后头晕、乏力、恶心呕吐；这次发作在情绪激动之后。7 年前她因长 QT 和一种危险的心律失常就诊，并做过左心交感神经切除。心电图 QTc 0.58 s、室性早搏二联律，血钾 3.3 mmol/L。她晕倒最可能的机制是什么？
prompt.en: Since yesterday she has blacked out repeatedly: the first time she came round after a few minutes; she was incontinent of urine and afterwards dizzy, weak, nauseated and vomiting; this attack followed emotional upset. Seven years ago she was seen for long QT and a dangerous arrhythmia and had a left cardiac sympathetic denervation. Her ECG shows QTc 0.58 s with ventricular bigeminy; potassium is 3.3 mmol/L. What is the most likely mechanism of her blackouts?

need.zh-CN: 先问清晕倒的经过、诱因和她过去的心脏病史与手术，并读完第一份心电图和血电解质。
need.en: First take the story of the blackouts, what set them off and her heart history and operation, and read the first ECG and electrolytes.

text.zh-CN: 长 QT 综合征背景下尖端扭转型室速所致的心律失常性晕厥，低钾和停用 β 受体阻滞剂是促发因素
text.en: Arrhythmic syncope from torsade de pointes in long-QT syndrome, with the low potassium and the stopped beta-blocker as precipitants

feedback.zh-CN: 对。已知长 QT 的患者反复晕倒，QTc 0.58 s 伴室性早搏二联律，血钾 3.3 mmol/L，又停了 β 受体阻滞剂——在证明不是之前，都要按心律失常性晕厥处理。ESC 2018 晕厥指南把提示长 QT 综合征的心电图列为高危特征；ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南指出低钾和延长 QT 的药物会诱发长 QT 患者的心律失常。尿失禁和醒后呕吐并不能把它与心源性晕厥区分开。
feedback.en: Right. Repeated blackouts in known long QT, with a QTc of 0.58 s, ventricular bigeminy, a potassium of 3.3 mmol/L and a stopped beta-blocker, are arrhythmic until proven otherwise. ESC 2018 syncope counts an ECG pointing to long-QT syndrome among the high-risk features, and ESC 2022 VA/SCD names hypokalaemia and QT-prolonging drugs as precipitants of arrhythmia in LQTS. Incontinence and vomiting after waking do not separate this from cardiac syncope.

text.zh-CN: 癫痫发作：意识丧失时尿失禁，醒后头晕乏力是发作后状态；心电图上的改变是抽搐之后的继发表现，应先请神经内科
text.en: Epileptic seizures: incontinence during the loss of consciousness and a post-ictal phase of dizziness and weakness; the ECG changes follow the fits, so neurology comes first

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。尿失禁在晕厥和癫痫发作中都可出现，不能据此诊断癫痫；醒后头晕、乏力也不等于发作后意识模糊。长 QT 患者的晕倒常被误当作癫痫而延误治疗——她的 QTc 0.58 s 是原发问题，不是抽搐的结果。ESC 2018 晕厥指南要求先评估心律失常这一高危原因。
feedback.en: No. Incontinence occurs in syncope as well as in seizures and does not establish epilepsy, and dizziness and weakness on waking are not post-ictal confusion. Blackouts in long QT are classically mistaken for epilepsy, delaying treatment — her QTc of 0.58 s is the primary problem, not the result of a fit. ESC 2018 syncope puts the high-risk, arrhythmic cause first.

text.zh-CN: 情绪诱发的反射性（血管迷走性）晕厥：情绪激动后发作并伴恶心呕吐；QTc 延长主要是低钾造成的
text.en: Reflex (vasovagal) syncope set off by emotion, with nausea and vomiting; the long QTc is mainly the effect of the low potassium

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。情绪诱因和恶心呕吐可见于血管迷走性晕厥，但长 QT 患者恰恰会在情绪激动等肾上腺素能刺激下发生尖端扭转。已知长 QT、QTc 0.58 s 和室性早搏二联律都是 ESC 2018 晕厥指南所说的高危特征，反射性晕厥解释不了；低钾会让 QT 更长，却解释不了 7 年前就已诊断的长 QT。
feedback.en: No. An emotional trigger and nausea fit vasovagal syncope, but in long QT torsade is set off precisely by emotion and other adrenergic surges. Known long QT, a QTc of 0.58 s and ventricular bigeminy are high-risk features in ESC 2018 syncope that reflex syncope does not explain; the low potassium lengthens the QT further but cannot account for a long QT diagnosed seven years ago.

text.zh-CN: 单纯低钾引起的获得性 QT 延长：补钾使血钾正常后风险即可解除，不必再考虑先天性原因
text.en: An acquired long QT from hypokalaemia alone: once the potassium is normal the risk is gone, and no inherited cause needs considering

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。低钾确实会延长 QT、诱发尖端扭转，必须纠正；但她 7 年前就因长 QT 就诊并做过手术，先天性长 QT 不会因为补钾而消失。ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南把纠正电解质列为长 QT 患者的长期防范措施之一，它是诱因，而不是病因的全部。
feedback.en: No. Hypokalaemia does lengthen the QT and invite torsade, and it must be corrected — but she was seen for long QT seven years ago and had an operation for it, and congenital long QT does not go away with potassium. ESC 2022 VA/SCD lists correcting electrolytes among the standing precautions in LQTS: a precipitant, not the whole cause.

prompt.zh-CN: 你判断她是心律失常性晕厥。她现在神志清楚，仍在急诊；心电图 QTc 0.58 s、室性早搏二联律，血钾 3.3 mmol/L；她术后服普萘洛尔约 1 年后自行停药。接下来这一小时你怎么处理？
prompt.en: You judge her blackouts to be arrhythmic. She is alert and still in the emergency department; her ECG shows QTc 0.58 s with ventricular bigeminy, potassium is 3.3 mmol/L, and she stopped her propranolol herself after about a year. What is your plan for the next hour?

need.zh-CN: 先作答决策 1，并问清她的用药情况。
need.en: First answer decision 1 and find out about her medicines.

text.zh-CN: 立即上监护、贴好除颤电极；静脉硫酸镁 2 g，补钾至 4.5–5.0 mmol/L；不用延长 QT 的药，恢复普萘洛尔，住监护病床
text.en: Monitoring with defibrillator pads on now; magnesium sulfate 2 g IV, potassium up to 4.5–5.0 mmol/L; no QT-prolonging drugs; propranolol restarted; a monitored bed

feedback.zh-CN: 对。尖端扭转随时可能发生：持续心电监护，除颤仪立即可用（ESC 2018 晕厥指南：怀疑心律失常性晕厥的高危患者在床旁或遥测下监护）。镁剂是尖端扭转的首选药物（英国复苏委员会 2026 快速性心律失常流程），同时把血钾提高到 4.5–5.0 mmol/L（AHA/ACCF 2010 声明）；ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南要求长 QT 患者避免延长 QT 的药物，并首选非选择性 β 受体阻滞剂（纳多洛尔或普萘洛尔）。
feedback.en: Right. Torsade could start at any moment: continuous ECG monitoring with a defibrillator ready to use (ESC 2018 syncope: monitoring in bed or by telemetry for high-risk patients with suspected arrhythmic syncope). Magnesium is the first drug for torsade (RCUK 2026 tachyarrhythmia algorithm), and potassium goes up to 4.5–5.0 mmol/L (AHA/ACCF 2010 statement); ESC 2022 VA/SCD asks LQTS patients to avoid QT-prolonging drugs and to take a non-selective beta-blocker (nadolol or propranolol).

text.zh-CN: 恢复普萘洛尔并口服补钾，佩戴 24 小时动态心电图后回家，1 周内心内科门诊复诊，并嘱咐她避免情绪激动
text.en: Restart propranolol and oral potassium, send her home with a 24-hour Holter and a cardiology clinic visit within a week, and advise her to avoid emotional upset

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。已知长 QT、QTc 0.58 s、室性早搏二联律合并低钾的反复晕倒属于高危晕厥，需要住院持续心电监护（ESC 2018 晕厥指南）；动态心电图只能事后记录，发作时不能除颤。恢复普萘洛尔和补钾本身是对的，但要在监护下进行。
feedback.en: No. Repeated blackouts with known long QT, a QTc of 0.58 s, bigeminy and hypokalaemia are high-risk syncope that needs admission and continuous monitoring (ESC 2018 syncope); a Holter only records after the event and cannot defibrillate. Restarting propranolol and potassium is right in itself — under monitoring.

text.zh-CN: 在心电监护下静脉负荷胺碘酮抑制室性早搏二联律，经静脉补钾，用昂丹司琼静脉注射止吐，硫酸镁留到再次发作时再给，平稳后收入心内科普通病房
text.en: Load amiodarone IV under monitoring to suppress the bigeminy, replace potassium IV, give IV ondansetron for the vomiting, keep magnesium for another attack, and admit her to a general cardiology ward once settled

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。胺碘酮和昂丹司琼都会延长 QT：英国复苏委员会 2026 快速性心律失常流程要求 QT 延长的多形性室速避免胺碘酮，美国 FDA（2011）建议先天性长 QT 患者避免昂丹司琼。监护和补钾是对的，但应加用镁剂，并留在随时能除颤的监护病床，而不是普通病房。
feedback.en: No. Amiodarone and ondansetron both prolong the QT: the RCUK 2026 tachyarrhythmia algorithm avoids amiodarone in polymorphic VT with a long QT, and the US FDA (2011) advises against ondansetron in congenital long QT. Monitoring and potassium are right, but add magnesium and keep her on a bed with immediate defibrillation, not a general ward.

text.zh-CN: 收入神经内科做脑电图和头颅影像，先给左乙拉西坦，在病房口服补钾，暂时不需要持续心电监护
text.en: Admit under neurology for an EEG and brain imaging, start levetiracetam and give oral potassium on the ward, with no need for continuous ECG monitoring for now

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这是把心律失常性晕厥当成癫痫的典型误判：脑电图和抗癫痫药都挡不住尖端扭转，离开心电监护，下一次发作就可能致命。ESC 2018 晕厥指南要求对怀疑心律失常性晕厥的高危患者先做心电监护和心脏评估。
feedback.en: No. This is the classic misreading of arrhythmic syncope as epilepsy: an EEG and an anti-seizure drug do nothing against torsade, and off the monitor her next attack could be fatal. ESC 2018 syncope puts ECG monitoring and cardiac assessment first in high-risk patients with suspected arrhythmic syncope.

prompt.zh-CN: 她已在监护病床上。发作时的监护记录显示反复出现尖端扭转型室速：有的持续数秒后自行终止，有的需要紧急电复律。她这次发作是在情绪激动之后开始的。现在怎样处理这些反复的发作？
prompt.en: She is on the monitored bed. The monitor recordings of her attacks show recurrent torsade de pointes: some runs stopped by themselves after a few seconds, others needed emergency cardioversion. This episode began after emotional upset. How do you treat the recurring torsade now?

need.zh-CN: 先在监护病床上调阅发作时的监护记录。
need.en: First review the monitor recordings of her attacks on the monitored bed.

text.zh-CN: 持续或无脉的发作立即电除颤；重复静脉硫酸镁，血钾维持 4.5–5.0 mmol/L，给普萘洛尔，停用延长 QT 的药；仍反复则临时起搏
text.en: Defibrillate sustained or pulseless runs at once; repeat IV magnesium, keep potassium at 4.5–5.0 mmol/L, give propranolol, stop QT-prolonging drugs; pace temporarily if runs keep coming

feedback.zh-CN: 对。持续或导致意识丧失的尖端扭转立即电除颤；镁剂是尖端扭转的首选药物（英国复苏委员会 2026 快速性心律失常流程：8 mmol，约 2 g，10 分钟以上静脉注射），血钾提高到 4.5–5.0 mmol/L，停用一切延长 QT 的药物（AHA/ACCF 2010 声明）。她这次发作由情绪激动诱发，β 受体阻滞剂是对抗这种肾上腺素能触发的基础（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南）；药物控制不住时，再由心律失常团队考虑临时起搏。
feedback.en: Right. Shock torsade that persists or causes collapse at once; magnesium is the first drug for torsade (RCUK 2026 tachyarrhythmia algorithm: 8 mmol, about 2 g, IV over 10 minutes), potassium goes up to 4.5–5.0 mmol/L and every QT-prolonging drug stops (AHA/ACCF 2010 statement). This episode followed emotional upset, and a beta-blocker is the foundation against that adrenergic trigger (ESC 2022 VA/SCD); if drugs fail, the arrhythmia team considers temporary pacing.

text.zh-CN: 按室颤/无脉室速流程处理：第 3 次电击后静脉注射胺碘酮 300 mg，随后胺碘酮静脉维持，同时补钾补镁，持续的发作照常给予非同步电除颤
text.en: Follow the VF/pulseless VT algorithm: amiodarone 300 mg IV after the third shock, then an amiodarone infusion, with potassium and magnesium, and unsynchronised shocks for sustained runs as usual

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。胺碘酮本身延长 QT，英国复苏委员会 2026 快速性心律失常流程要求 QT 延长的多形性室速避免使用——她反复发作的尖端扭转正属于这种情况，所以心搏骤停流程里的胺碘酮在这里不是答案。电除颤和补钾补镁是对的。
feedback.en: No. Amiodarone itself prolongs the QT, and the RCUK 2026 tachyarrhythmia algorithm says to avoid it in polymorphic VT with QT prolongation — which is what her recurring torsade is, so the arrest algorithm's amiodarone is not the answer here. The shocks, potassium and magnesium are right.

text.zh-CN: 静脉泵入异丙肾上腺素，把心率提高到每分钟 100 次左右以缩短 QT，同时补钾补镁，持续的发作电除颤
text.en: An isoprenaline infusion to lift the heart rate to about 100 a minute and shorten the QT, with potassium and magnesium, and shocks for sustained runs

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。用异丙肾上腺素提高心率适用于伴心动过缓、长间歇依赖的获得性尖端扭转：ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南推荐，获得性长 QT 在补镁后仍反复尖端扭转时用异丙肾上腺素或起搏。她是先天性长 QT，这次发作在情绪激动之后——肾上腺素能刺激正是诱因，β 受体阻滞剂才是治疗（ESC 2022），异丙肾上腺素可能诱发更多尖端扭转；本病例也没有记录发作前有心动过缓或长间歇。需要提高心率时，由心律失常团队起搏。
feedback.en: No. Raising the rate with isoprenaline suits acquired, pause-dependent torsade with a slow heart rate: ESC 2022 VA/SCD recommends isoprenaline or pacing for torsade that keeps recurring in acquired long QT despite magnesium. Hers is congenital long QT and this episode followed emotional upset — adrenergic stimulation is the trigger and a beta-blocker the treatment (ESC 2022), so isoprenaline risks more torsade; this case records no bradycardia or pauses before her attacks either. If the rate must be raised, the arrhythmia team paces.

text.zh-CN: 每次发作都在镇静下同步电复律，并暂停普萘洛尔，因为它会减慢心率、延长停搏间歇，反而诱发尖端扭转
text.en: Synchronised cardioversion under sedation for every run, and hold propranolol because slowing the heart lengthens the pauses that invite torsade

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。数秒后自行终止的短阵发作不需要电击，持续或导致意识丧失的发作则要立即除颤，不必等镇静；多形性室速往往无法同步。暂停 β 受体阻滞剂是获得性、长间歇依赖性尖端扭转的思路；情绪诱发的先天性长 QT 恰恰需要 β 受体阻滞剂（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南）。
feedback.en: No. Runs that stop by themselves after a few seconds need no shock, while sustained runs with collapse need immediate defibrillation, not a wait for sedation — and polymorphic VT often cannot be synchronised. Holding the beta-blocker follows the logic of acquired, pause-dependent torsade; emotion-triggered congenital long QT needs the beta-blocker (ESC 2022 VA/SCD).

prompt.zh-CN: 她的病情已经稳定，复查心电图 QTc 0.61 s。这次复发距离左心交感神经切除已 7 年，发生在她自行停用普萘洛尔之后，诱因是情绪激动；家里没有人有类似的晕倒。你怎样判断她今后的风险和分型？
prompt.en: She has stabilised, and her repeat ECG shows QTc 0.61 s. This recurrence came seven years after her left cardiac sympathetic denervation, after she had stopped her propranolol herself, and followed emotional upset; no one in her family has had similar blackouts. How do you read her future risk and her subtype?

need.zh-CN: 先复查她病情稳定后的心电图，并问过家族史。
need.en: First repeat her ECG now that she has stabilised, and ask about her family.

text.zh-CN: 风险仍高：QTc 仍远超 0.5 s，去神经术后停药时复发且需电复律；情绪诱因只是分型线索，要靠基因检测，家族无人晕倒也排除不了
text.en: Still high-risk: QTc far above 0.5 s and a relapse needing shocks, off beta-blockers, after denervation; the trigger only hints at a subtype — genetic testing types it — and a family free of blackouts excludes nothing

feedback.zh-CN: 对。ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南以 QTc ≥ 480 ms 诊断长 QT 综合征，QTc 越长、有过心律失常事件，风险越高；她恢复后 QTc 仍为 0.61 s，并在去神经术后发生了需要电复律的尖端扭转。情绪诱因与某些亚型相符，但不能代替基因检测（EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 基因检测共识）；家族性长 QT 的许多携带者从未晕倒，家族史阴性什么也排除不了。
feedback.en: Right. ESC 2022 VA/SCD diagnoses LQTS at a QTc of 480 ms or more, and a longer QTc and a previous arrhythmic event raise the risk; after recovery hers is still 0.61 s, and she had torsade needing shocks after denervation. An emotional trigger fits some subtypes but cannot replace genetic testing (EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 genetic testing consensus), and many carriers of familial LQTS never black out, so a negative family history excludes nothing.

text.zh-CN: 情绪激动后发作已足以确定是 2 型长 QT，基因检测不会改变处理；只要坚持补钾、避免情绪刺激，她的风险就会降到很低
text.en: An attack after emotional upset establishes LQT2, so genetic testing would change nothing; with potassium supplements and no emotional stress her risk becomes low

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。情绪或突然的声响诱发与 2 型长 QT 相符，但诱因只是线索，确定不了分型；分型会影响治疗（如 3 型长 QT 可加用美西律）和亲属的级联检测（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南；EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 共识）。补钾和避免诱因也替代不了 β 受体阻滞剂。
feedback.en: No. Triggering by emotion or sudden noise fits LQT2, but a trigger is a clue, not a genotype; the genotype shapes treatment (mexiletine in LQT3, for example) and cascade testing of relatives (ESC 2022 VA/SCD; EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 consensus). Potassium and avoiding triggers do not replace a beta-blocker.

text.zh-CN: 发作已控制、血钾也纠正了，她的风险已回到这次发病前的水平；QTc 0.61 s 只是近期电复律和低钾留下的暂时改变，不需要特别处理
text.en: With the attacks controlled and the potassium corrected, her risk is back to where it was before this episode; the QTc of 0.61 s is a passing effect of the recent shocks and the low potassium, needing no special action

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。风险并没有归零：QTc 0.61 s 是在病情稳定时测得的，远超 0.5 s；本病例没有记录当时的血钾，但先天性长 QT 不会因补钾而消失。ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南结合 QTc 和症状判断风险——而她刚刚经历过需要电复律的尖端扭转。
feedback.en: No. The risk has not reset: the QTc of 0.61 s was measured once she was stable and is far above 0.5 s; this case does not record her potassium at that time, but congenital long QT does not disappear with potassium. ESC 2022 VA/SCD weighs the QTc together with symptoms — and she has just had torsade needing shocks.

text.zh-CN: 复发说明当年的去神经手术做得不彻底：应尽快再次（双侧）去神经，之后就可以停用 β 受体阻滞剂，也不必评估 ICD
text.en: The recurrence shows the denervation was incomplete: repeat it, bilaterally, soon — after which the beta-blocker can stop and no ICD assessment is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。左心交感神经切除能减少但不能消除心律失常事件；ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南把它作为有症状患者的补充治疗（不能或拒绝植入 ICD，或已有 ICD 仍反复电击时），而不是 β 受体阻滞剂的替代，也不是高危患者 ICD 的替代。先恢复足量 β 受体阻滞剂并评估 ICD。
feedback.en: No. Left cardiac sympathetic denervation reduces but does not abolish arrhythmic events; ESC 2022 VA/SCD uses it as a complement for symptomatic patients (when an ICD is contraindicated or declined, or shocks recur despite one), not as a substitute for a beta-blocker or, in high-risk patients, for an ICD. Restore a full-dose beta-blocker and assess for an ICD first.

prompt.zh-CN: 她准备出院。下面哪些应当写进她的出院计划？（多选）
prompt.en: She is ready to go home. Which of these belong in her discharge plan? (Select all that apply.)

text.zh-CN: 长期服用非选择性 β 受体阻滞剂（普萘洛尔或纳多洛尔）至可耐受的足量，并和她一起找出当初停药的原因、商定坚持服药的办法
text.en: A non-selective beta-blocker (propranolol or nadolol) long term at the full tolerated dose, working out with her why she stopped before and how she will keep taking it

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南推荐 QT 延长的长 QT 患者使用 β 受体阻滞剂，首选非选择性的纳多洛尔或普萘洛尔。她这次复发时已自行停药，所以出院计划必须包括坚持服药的具体办法，而不仅仅是一张处方。
feedback.en: Include it. ESC 2022 VA/SCD recommends a beta-blocker, preferably non-selective nadolol or propranolol, for LQTS with a prolonged QT. She had stopped hers herself when this recurrence came, so the plan needs a concrete way to keep her taking it, not just a prescription.

text.zh-CN: 转诊遗传性心律失常团队，在 β 受体阻滞剂基础上评估植入 ICD，并与她共同决策
text.en: Referral to an inherited-arrhythmia team to assess an ICD on top of the beta-blocker, as a decision shared with her

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。她在去神经术后发生了需要电复律的尖端扭转，恢复后 QTc 仍为 0.61 s。ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南推荐心搏骤停幸存者，以及服用 β 受体阻滞剂期间仍有心律失常性晕厥或血流动力学不能耐受的室速者，在 β 受体阻滞剂基础上植入 ICD；她的电击发作算不算心搏骤停、停药期间的发作如何权衡，需要专科评估并与她共同决定。本病例没有记录当时是否讨论过 ICD。
feedback.en: Include it. She had torsade needing shocks after denervation, and her QTc is still 0.61 s after recovery. ESC 2022 VA/SCD recommends an ICD, on top of a beta-blocker, after a cardiac arrest and for arrhythmic syncope or poorly tolerated VT despite beta-blockers; whether her shocked runs count as an arrest, and how to weigh events off treatment, is a specialist judgement made with her. This case does not record whether an ICD was discussed.

text.zh-CN: 遗传咨询和长 QT 基因检测，并为父母、兄弟姐妹和子女等一级亲属安排心电图筛查
text.en: Genetic counselling and long-QT gene testing, with ECG screening of her first-degree relatives

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南推荐临床诊断的长 QT 患者接受遗传咨询和基因检测；找到致病变异后，亲属可以做针对性检测（EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 共识）。家里没有人晕倒并不能排除——一级亲属都应查心电图。
feedback.en: Include it. ESC 2022 VA/SCD recommends genetic counselling and testing in clinically diagnosed LQTS, and a disease-causing variant lets relatives be tested for it (EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 consensus). A family without blackouts excludes nothing: her first-degree relatives should all have an ECG.

text.zh-CN: 植入 ICD 之后就停用 β 受体阻滞剂，因为以后再有发作，都可以交给除颤器自动处理
text.en: Implant an ICD and then stop the beta-blocker, since the device will deal with any further attack

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。ICD 只能在心律失常发生后放电，并不能预防发作；没有 β 受体阻滞剂，长 QT 患者可能反复发作、反复被电击。ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南把 ICD 放在 β 受体阻滞剂的基础之上，而不是替代它。
feedback.en: Leave it out. An ICD shocks an arrhythmia once it has started and prevents none; without a beta-blocker a patient with LQTS may have repeated attacks and repeated shocks. ESC 2022 VA/SCD puts the ICD on top of beta-blockade, not in its place.

text.zh-CN: 不再使用 β 受体阻滞剂，改为依靠当年做过的左心交感神经切除，再加上长期口服补钾，来预防以后复发
text.en: No beta-blocker: rely on the earlier left cardiac sympathetic denervation and long-term potassium tablets to prevent recurrences

feedback.zh-CN: 不应选。这正是她这次复发时的处境：去神经术后自行停了普萘洛尔，这次又在情绪激动后、血钾偏低时发作。左心交感神经切除是补充治疗，口服补钾也替代不了 β 受体阻滞剂（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南）。
feedback.en: Leave it out. That was her situation when this recurrence came: denervation done, propranolol stopped by herself, then this episode after emotional upset with a low potassium. Denervation is a complement, and potassium tablets cannot replace a beta-blocker (ESC 2022 VA/SCD).

text.zh-CN: 问清晕倒的起始和经过（首次几分钟后苏醒、此后反复）、尿失禁、醒后症状和情绪诱因
text.en: Established when the blackouts began and how they went (coming round after minutes, then recurring), the incontinence, the after-symptoms and the emotional trigger

text.zh-CN: 询问既往长 QT 病史、去神经手术、普萘洛尔的使用与自行停药、其他在用药物，以及家族中的晕倒和猝死
text.en: Asked about the earlier long-QT diagnosis, the denervation, propranolol and stopping it, any other current medicines, and blackouts or sudden death in the family

text.zh-CN: 检查了神志与一般情况、听力、心脏和双肺
text.en: Examined her consciousness and general state, hearing, heart and lungs

text.zh-CN: 在急诊记录并阅读 12 导联心电图和血电解质，并送检血镁
text.en: In the emergency department, recorded and read a 12-lead ECG and the electrolytes, and sent a magnesium level

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认出这是长 QT 背景下尖端扭转所致的晕倒
text.en: Recognised blackouts from torsade in long QT at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 还在急诊时就给她接上持续心电监护并贴好除颤电极
text.en: Put her on continuous ECG monitoring with defibrillator pads while she was still in the emergency department

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即定下第一小时的方案，并实际给了镁剂、补钾和普萘洛尔，把她收入监护病床
text.en: Set the first-hour plan at the first attempt and actually gave magnesium, potassium and propranolol and admitted her to a monitored bed

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确处理反复的尖端扭转，在监护病床上读到监护记录后对发作电除颤，并请心律失常团队会诊
text.en: Treated the recurring torsade correctly at the first attempt, shocking her runs on the monitored bed once the recordings were read, and calling the arrhythmia team

text.zh-CN: 没有给昂丹司琼、胺碘酮或异丙肾上腺素，只在监护病床上电击，也没有让她从急诊或监护病床直接回家
text.en: Gave no ondansetron, amiodarone or isoprenaline, shocked her only on the monitored bed, and did not send her home from the emergency department or the monitored bed

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断她恢复后仍属高危，分型要靠基因检测
text.en: Judged at the first attempt that she stays high-risk after recovery and that her subtype needs genetic testing

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即定下出院计划，并实际安排了 ICD 评估、遗传咨询、亲属筛查和出院宣教
text.en: Set the discharge plan at the first attempt and actually arranged the ICD assessment, genetic counselling, relatives' screening and discharge teaching

text.zh-CN: 用她听得懂的话解释病情和治疗，了解她为什么停药，并就 ICD、基因检测和家属筛查与她共同决策
text.en: Explained the problem and treatment in words she could follow, explored why she stopped her tablets, and shared the decisions on the ICD, genetic testing and family screening with her

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、采集信息、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，先了解她对这几次晕倒的理解和担心；用通俗的话解释——她心脏的电活动“复原”比一般人慢（长QT），血钾偏低和停药让一种危险的快速心律更容易出现，所以要马上接监护、准备好除颤，并补镁、补钾、恢复普萘洛尔；不带评判地问她当初为什么停药，一起商量怎样坚持服药；坦诚回应她“还会不会再犯”的担心，不作虚假保证，也不承诺病例没有记录的结局；出院前说明 ICD 评估的好处和负担、需要她一起决定，基因检测能说明什么并取得她的同意，以及为什么父母、兄弟姐妹和子女都要查心电图，并给她一份需要避开的药物清单；确认她听懂了，留出提问的时间。不编造病例中没有的检查结果或数字。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering information, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves and first finds out what she understands and fears about the blackouts; explains in plain words that her heart's electrical recovery is slower than usual (long QT) and that the low potassium and stopping her tablets made a dangerous fast rhythm more likely — hence the monitor and defibrillator now, and the magnesium, potassium and propranolol; asks without judgement why she stopped the propranolol and agrees with her how she will keep taking it; answers her worry that it will happen again honestly, without false reassurance or promises about an outcome the case does not record; before discharge explains the ICD assessment as a decision for her to share, with its benefits and burdens, what genetic testing can show and her consent to it, and why her parents, siblings and children should have an ECG, and gives her a list of medicines to avoid; checks understanding and leaves time for questions. Invents no result or number the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 到院交班（ISBAR）：28岁女性，从昨天开始反复晕倒，刚到急诊，现在神志清楚。急诊床旁有监护除颤仪、心电图机和抢救车（留置针和急救药品）；收住的监护床位在重症监护区，病房有心电图机、床旁监护仪、除颤仪和抢救车，护士站有病历终端；心脏超声机要从影像科推来。复述医嘱并完成护理范围内的操作（接监护、贴电极片、静脉通路、按医嘱给药）；只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到生命体征、血镁、发作次数或电击次数时，如实说没有可报的记录，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: Handover on arrival (ISBAR): a 28-year-old woman who has blacked out repeatedly since yesterday, just arrived in the emergency department and alert now. At the bedside in the department: a monitor-defibrillator, the ECG machine and the crash cart (cannulas and emergency drugs); the monitored beds she would be admitted to are in the critical care area, and the ward has an ECG machine, bedside monitors, a defibrillator and a crash cart, with a records terminal at the nurses' station; the echo machine has to be brought from imaging. Reads orders back and carries out nursing-scope tasks (monitoring, pads, IV access, drugs as prescribed); reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for vital signs, a magnesium level, the number of attacks or of shocks, says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never gives a number.

name.zh-CN: 邵医生（心内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“尿失禁能说明她是癫痫吗？”“这份心电图上哪一个数字最让你担心？今天还有什么在把它拉长？”“如果她十分钟后又晕倒，她应该在哪里、身上接着什么？”“为什么这里不用胺碘酮？为什么不用异丙肾上腺素？”“她平稳了，就说明风险过去了吗？”“家里没人晕倒，能说明家族里没有长 QT 吗？”。可以讲解 ESC 2018 晕厥指南、ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南、英国复苏委员会快速性心律失常流程和 EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 基因检测共识的相关原则；学员读过结局记录之后，可以对照记录的经过（补钾补镁、电复律、恢复普萘洛尔）与现行做法（ICD 评估、遗传咨询、家属筛查——记录中都没有提到）。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例中没有的资料（生命体征、血镁、发作次数和持续时间、发作前有无长间歇、电击次数和能量、药物剂量、基因型、她停药的原因都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about what the learner already has, e.g. “Does the incontinence make this epilepsy?”, “Which number on this tracing worries you most, and what else is lengthening it today?”, “If she blacks out again in ten minutes, where should she be and what should be on her?”, “Why not amiodarone here? Why not isoprenaline?”, “She is settled — does that mean the risk has passed?”, “Nobody in the family has blacked out — does that rule out familial long QT?”. May explain the relevant principles of ESC 2018 syncope, ESC 2022 VA/SCD, the RCUK tachyarrhythmia algorithm and the EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 genetic testing consensus, and — once the learner has read the outcome record — contrast the recorded course (electrolyte replacement, shocks, propranolol restarted) with current practice (an ICD assessment, genetic counselling and family screening, none of which the record mentions). Never states the diagnosis or any decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds no data the case lacks (vital signs, magnesium, the number and length of the attacks, whether pauses preceded them, the number and energy of shocks, drug doses, the genotype and why she stopped her tablets are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 雷医生（心脏电生理医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 心脏电生理医生，接到会诊或 ICD 评估转诊后参与。只解读学员已经读过的心电图、监护记录和心脏超声：QTc 的测量与校正在心率快或有早搏二联律时的局限；尖端扭转的识别及与其他多形性室速的区别；尖端扭转的急性处理（电除颤、镁剂、补钾、停用延长 QT 的药物、药物无效时临时起搏）；先天性长 QT 中非选择性 β 受体阻滞剂的地位；左心交感神经切除的作用与局限；ICD 共同决策、1-2-3-LQTS-Risk 风险评估和基因检测的意义。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造发作次数、电击能量、发作前的长间歇、基因型或任何测量值（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Cardiac electrophysiologist who joins when consulted or when an ICD assessment is requested. Interprets only the ECGs, monitor recordings and echocardiogram the learner has read: measuring and correcting the QT, and its limits at fast rates or with bigeminy; recognising torsade and telling it from other polymorphic VT; the acute treatment of torsade (defibrillation, magnesium, potassium, stopping QT-prolonging drugs, temporary pacing when drugs fail); the place of non-selective beta-blockers in congenital long QT; what left cardiac sympathetic denervation can and cannot do; shared ICD decisions, the 1-2-3-LQTS-Risk estimate and what genetic testing adds. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents the number of attacks, shock energies, pauses before the attacks, a genotype or any measurement (none is recorded).

knowledge.zh-CN: 临床药师，负责用药核查。可以说明常见的延长 QT 药物类别（部分止吐药如昂丹司琼、大环内酯类和氟喹诺酮类抗菌药、部分抗精神病药、美沙酮、胺碘酮和索他洛尔等抗心律失常药），以及按 CredibleMeds 等清单逐一核对新药的做法；静脉补钾必须稀释并用输液泵、绝不静脉推注；硫酸镁 2 g 约等于 8 mmol；长 QT 首选非选择性 β 受体阻滞剂（普萘洛尔、纳多洛尔）。只讲药学原则，不报出病例没有记录的剂量、血药浓度或检验数值，也不替学员作出诊断。
knowledge.en: Clinical pharmacist who reviews her drugs. Can explain the common QT-prolonging classes (some antiemetics such as ondansetron, macrolide and fluoroquinolone antibiotics, some antipsychotics, methadone, and antiarrhythmics such as amiodarone and sotalol) and the habit of checking every new drug against a list such as CredibleMeds; that IV potassium must be diluted and given by infusion pump, never as a push; that magnesium sulfate 2 g is about 8 mmol; and that non-selective beta-blockers (propranolol, nadolol) are preferred in long QT. Gives pharmaceutical principles only — no dose, drug level or laboratory value the case does not record — and never makes the diagnosis for the learner.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：反复晕倒、QT 延长与尖端扭转的防治
title.en: Debrief: repeated blackouts, a long QT and the prevention of torsade

conclusion.zh-CN: 28岁女性，7 年前因长 QT 和危险的心律失常就诊，行左心交感神经切除，术后服普萘洛尔约 1 年后自行停药。入院前 1 天起反复晕厥（这次在情绪激动后发作），晕厥时尿失禁，醒后头晕、乏力、恶心呕吐。心电图 QTc 0.58 s 伴室性早搏二联律，入院血钾 3.3 mmol/L，心脏超声结构与功能正常；监护记录到反复的尖端扭转型室速，部分数秒后自行终止，部分需紧急电复律。记录中的团队给予补钾补镁、电复律并恢复普萘洛尔；稳定时 QTc 0.61 s，住院 11 天出院，随访 1 年余未再晕厥。诊断：长 QT 综合征，去神经术后 7 年、停用 β 受体阻滞剂并低钾时反复发生尖端扭转。按现行指南（ESC 2018 晕厥指南、ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南；血钾目标据 AHA/ACCF 2010 声明），应从一开始就持续心电监护并备好除颤，给镁剂、补钾至 4.5–5.0 mmol/L、停用延长 QT 的药物、足量非选择性 β 受体阻滞剂，出院前评估 ICD、做基因检测并筛查一级亲属。
conclusion.en: A 28-year-old woman treated seven years earlier for long QT by left cardiac sympathetic denervation had stopped her propranolol herself after about a year. From the day before admission she blacked out repeatedly — this episode after emotional upset — with incontinence, then dizziness, weakness, nausea and vomiting. ECG: QTc 0.58 s, ventricular bigeminy; potassium 3.3 mmol/L; echocardiogram normal. Monitoring showed recurrent torsade de pointes, some runs self-terminating after seconds, others needing emergency shocks. The team gave potassium and magnesium, cardioverted her and restarted propranolol; once stable her QTc was 0.61 s; discharged at 11 days, she had no syncope for over a year. Diagnosis: long-QT syndrome with recurrent torsade, off beta-blockade and hypokalaemic. Today (ESC 2018 syncope; ESC 2022 VA/SCD; the potassium target from AHA/ACCF 2010): monitor and defibrillator at once, magnesium, potassium 4.5–5.0 mmol/L, no QT-prolonging drugs, full-dose non-selective beta-blockade, then ICD assessment, genetic testing and family screening.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 已知长 QT 的人反复晕倒，先按心律失常性晕厥处理；尿失禁、情绪诱因和醒后呕吐都不能把它改判为癫痫或血管迷走性晕厥。
keyReasoning.en: In someone with known long QT, repeated blackouts are arrhythmic until shown otherwise; incontinence, an emotional trigger and vomiting afterwards do not turn them into epilepsy or a faint.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 第一份心电图（QTc 0.58 s、室性早搏二联律）和血钾 3.3 mmol/L 同时摆出了基质和诱因：眼下的危险是尖端扭转，所以监护和除颤准备排在其他检查之前。
keyReasoning.en: The first ECG (QTc 0.58 s, ventricular bigeminy) and a potassium of 3.3 mmol/L show the substrate and a precipitant together: the danger now is torsade, so monitoring with a defibrillator comes before any other test.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 监护记录证实了反复的尖端扭转：治疗针对诱因和基质——电击持续的发作、镁剂、补钾、β 受体阻滞剂——并避开延长 QT 或加重肾上腺素能刺激的药物。
keyReasoning.en: The monitor recordings confirm recurrent torsade: treatment targets the triggers and the substrate — shocks for sustained runs, magnesium, potassium, beta-blockade — and avoids drugs that lengthen the QT or add adrenergic drive.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 恢复后 QTc 仍为 0.61 s、去神经术后 7 年在停药时复发，说明她仍是高危；之后平静的一年改变不了这一点。
keyReasoning.en: A QTc still at 0.61 s after recovery, and a relapse seven years after denervation while off treatment, keep her high-risk; the quiet year that followed does not change that.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 情绪诱因和家族史阴性只是线索：分型和家族风险要靠基因检测和亲属心电图筛查来回答。
keyReasoning.en: An emotional trigger and a family without blackouts are clues, not answers: genotype and family risk need genetic testing and ECG screening of relatives.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明哪一项治疗起了作用，也不能证明 1 年余没有晕厥代表风险已经消失。病例没有记录生命体征、血镁、发作次数和电击能量、药物剂量、基因型和更远期的随访；分阶段安排、决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show which treatment worked, or that a year without syncope means the risk has gone. Vital signs, magnesium, the number of episodes and shock energies, drug doses, genotype and longer follow-up are not recorded; the staging, decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 各阶段的生命体征，以及每份心电图和血钾的准确时间。
unknowns.en: Vital signs at any point, and the exact times of each ECG and of the potassium result.

unknowns.zh-CN: 血镁、血钙和其他血液检查结果，以及血糖和妊娠试验。
unknowns.en: Magnesium, calcium and other blood results, and a glucose and a pregnancy test.

unknowns.zh-CN: 尖端扭转的发作次数、持续时间和起始方式（发作前有无心动过缓或长间歇），以及电击的次数和能量。
unknowns.en: The number, length and onset pattern of the torsade episodes (whether bradycardia or pauses came first), and the number and energy of the shocks.

unknowns.zh-CN: 补钾、补镁和普萘洛尔的剂量、途径和时间，她是否还在用其他药物，以及她当初为什么停用普萘洛尔。
unknowns.en: The doses, routes and timing of the potassium, magnesium and propranolol, whether she was taking any other drugs, and why she stopped the propranolol.

unknowns.zh-CN: 她的基因型、7 年前的心电图和手术记录，以及手术以后到这次之前有没有再晕倒过。
unknowns.en: Her genotype, the ECGs and operation note from seven years ago, and whether she had blacked out between the operation and this admission.

unknowns.zh-CN: 是否讨论或植入了 ICD，是否做了遗传咨询和亲属筛查，以及家族中有无猝死。
unknowns.en: Whether an ICD was discussed or implanted, whether genetic counselling or screening of relatives took place, and any sudden death in the family.

unknowns.zh-CN: 出院 1 年余以后的情况，以及随访时的 QTc。
unknowns.en: Her course beyond about a year after discharge, and her QTc at follow-up.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 晕倒伴尿失禁不等于癫痫。ESC 2018 晕厥指南把提示长 QT 综合征的心电图列为高危特征，并要求对怀疑心律失常性晕厥的高危患者在床旁或遥测下持续心电监护。记录与现行做法：记录中她的发作是在监护下捕捉到的；按现行做法，急诊一读到 QTc 0.58 s 就应接上监护、贴好除颤电极。
teachingPoints.en: Incontinence does not make a blackout epileptic. ESC 2018 syncope counts an ECG pointing to long-QT syndrome among the high-risk features and asks for continuous ECG monitoring, in bed or by telemetry, for high-risk patients with suspected arrhythmic syncope. Then and now: in the record her attacks were caught on the monitor; today she goes on the monitor, pads applied, in the emergency department as soon as the QTc of 0.58 s is read.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 尖端扭转的处理：持续或导致意识丧失的发作立即电除颤，停用一切延长 QT 的药物（AHA/ACCF 2010 声明）；硫酸镁 8 mmol（约 2 g）10 分钟以上静脉注射，避免胺碘酮（英国复苏委员会 2026 快速性心律失常流程）；补镁的同时补钾（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南），目标 4.5–5.0 mmol/L（AHA/ACCF 2010）。用异丙肾上腺素或起搏提高心率可抑制长间歇依赖的尖端扭转，ESC 2022 推荐用于获得性长 QT；情绪诱发的先天性长 QT 用 β 受体激动剂等于加重诱因，药物无效时以起搏提高心率。记录与现行做法：记录中的补钾补镁和电复律与现行做法一致，剂量没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Treating torsade: shock runs that persist or cause collapse at once, and stop every QT-prolonging drug (AHA/ACCF 2010 statement); magnesium sulfate 8 mmol (about 2 g) IV over 10 minutes, and no amiodarone (RCUK 2026 tachyarrhythmia algorithm); potassium supplemented with the magnesium (ESC 2022 VA/SCD), aiming for 4.5–5.0 mmol/L (AHA/ACCF 2010). Raising the rate with isoprenaline or pacing suppresses pause-dependent torsade, and ESC 2022 recommends it in acquired long QT; in emotion-triggered congenital long QT a beta-agonist adds the very trigger, so pacing raises the rate if drugs fail. Then and now: the recorded potassium, magnesium and shocks match current practice; the doses are not recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 长 QT 患者要远离延长 QT 的药物：ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南要求避免这类药物、纠正电解质紊乱；美国 FDA（2011 年药品安全通讯）建议先天性长 QT 综合征患者避免昂丹司琼。她醒后恶心呕吐，最顺手的止吐药恰恰是陷阱——任何新药都先对照 CredibleMeds 等清单核查，并在病历中标注。
teachingPoints.en: Keep QT-prolonging drugs away from long QT: ESC 2022 VA/SCD asks for them to be avoided and for electrolyte disturbances to be corrected, and the US FDA (Drug Safety Communication, 2011) advises against ondansetron in congenital long-QT syndrome. She was vomiting, so the easiest antiemetic is the trap — check every new drug against a list such as CredibleMeds, and flag the notes.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: β 受体阻滞剂是长 QT 的基础治疗：ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南推荐 QT 延长者使用，首选非选择性的纳多洛尔或普萘洛尔；左心交感神经切除是补充治疗（不能或拒绝 ICD、或有 ICD 仍反复电击时），不能替代 β 受体阻滞剂。记录与现行做法：她术后服药约 1 年后自行停药，术后 7 年复发；记录中的团队恢复了普萘洛尔——现行做法还要有明确的坚持服药计划。
teachingPoints.en: Beta-blockade is the foundation in long QT: ESC 2022 VA/SCD recommends it when the QT is prolonged, preferably non-selective nadolol or propranolol, and treats left cardiac sympathetic denervation as a complement (when an ICD is contraindicated or declined, or shocks recur despite one), never a replacement. Then and now: she stopped propranolol about a year after the operation and relapsed seven years after it; the recorded team restarted propranolol — current practice adds an explicit plan to keep her on it.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 出院前的三件事：ICD 评估、基因检测和亲属筛查。ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南推荐心搏骤停幸存者，以及服用 β 受体阻滞剂期间仍有心律失常性晕厥或血流动力学不能耐受室速者，在 β 受体阻滞剂基础上植入 ICD，并推荐临床诊断者做遗传咨询和基因检测；找到致病变异后为亲属做级联检测（EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 共识）。她稳定时 QTc 仍为 0.61 s，1 年余无晕厥不代表风险消失。记录与现行做法：记录没有提到 ICD、基因检测或亲属筛查。
teachingPoints.en: Three things before discharge: an ICD assessment, genetic testing and family screening. ESC 2022 VA/SCD recommends an ICD on top of a beta-blocker after a cardiac arrest and for arrhythmic syncope or poorly tolerated VT despite beta-blockers, and genetic counselling and testing in clinically diagnosed LQTS; a disease-causing variant then allows cascade testing of relatives (EHRA/HRS/APHRS/LAHRS 2022 consensus). Her QTc was still 0.61 s once stable, so a year without syncope does not mean the risk has gone. Then and now: the record mentions no ICD, genetic testing or family screening.
